title: An investor asked on a call for news only on real milestones — you say so, and the next review waits

objects.subject: Thursday's call
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for the time on Thursday's call — I enjoyed hearing how the pilot teams use Nimbus Labs, and the calendar sync sounds close.

Let's stay in touch.

Leah Varma
Partner, Lumen Ventures
